### Select a Match

::: {#match-data style="display: none;"}

{{< include _data_overview.md >}}

:::

```{=html}
<style>
.match-picker {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 6rem minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.75rem 1rem;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 36rem;
}

.match-picker label {
  margin: 0;
}

.match-picker select {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 0.5rem;
}
</style>

<div class="match-picker">
  <label for="pick-league">League:</label>
  <select id="pick-league"></select>

  <label for="pick-season">Season:</label>
  <select id="pick-season"></select>

  <label for="pick-matchday">Matchday:</label>
  <select id="pick-matchday"></select>

  <label for="pick-match">Match:</label>
  <select id="pick-match"></select>
</div>

<p id="selected-match"></p>

<script type="module">
const table = document.querySelector("#match-data table");

const games = Array.from(table.tBodies)
  .flatMap(body => Array.from(body.rows))
  .map(row => {
    const [league, season, matchday, game, date, id] =
      Array.from(row.cells, cell => cell.textContent.trim());

    return {league, season, matchday, game, date, id};
  });

const fields = ["league", "season", "matchday", "id"];
const labels = ["League", "Season", "Matchday", "Match"];
const dropdowns = [
  "pick-league", "pick-season", "pick-matchday", "pick-match"
].map(id => document.getElementById(id));

const byId = new Map(games.map(game => [game.id, game]));

function update(resetFrom = 0) {
  let available = games;

  dropdowns.forEach((dropdown, index) => {
    const field = fields[index];

    if (index >= resetFrom) {
      const values = [...new Set(available.map(game => game[field]))]
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, {numeric: true}));

    dropdown.replaceChildren(
    ...values.map(value => new Option(
        field === "id"
        ? `${byId.get(value).game} (${byId.get(value).date})`
        : value,
        value
    ))
    );

    dropdown.disabled = values.length === 0;
    dropdown.selectedIndex = values.length ? 0 : -1;
    }

    available = available.filter(game => game[field] === dropdown.value);
  });

  const matchId = dropdowns[3].value;

  window.selectedMatchId = matchId || null;

  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("match-selected", {
  detail: {matchId: window.selectedMatchId}
  }));
}

dropdowns.forEach((dropdown, index) => {
  dropdown.addEventListener("change", () => update(index + 1));
});

update();
</script>
```



### Match Overview
```{=html}
<style>
.match-score {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
}

.match-score > strong {
  font-size: 2rem;
  line-height: 2.5rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.team-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
}

.home .team-heading {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.away .team-heading {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.home { text-align: right; }
.away { text-align: left; }

.team-name {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  min-width: 0;
}

.team-circle {
  width: 2.5rem;
  height: 2.5rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border: 3px solid;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.goalscorers {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
</style>

<div class="match-score">
  <div class="home">
    <div class="team-heading">
      <span id="home-circle" class="team-circle" hidden aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <span id="score-home" class="team-name"></span>
    </div>
    <div id="home-scorers" class="goalscorers"></div>
  </div>

  <strong id="score-result"></strong>

  <div class="away">
    <div class="team-heading">
      <span id="score-away" class="team-name"></span>
      <span id="away-circle" class="team-circle" hidden aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </div>
    <div id="away-scorers" class="goalscorers"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<p id="score-message" role="status"></p>

<script type="module">
const home = document.getElementById("score-home");
const away = document.getElementById("score-away");
const score = document.getElementById("score-result");
const message = document.getElementById("score-message");

const homeCircle = document.getElementById("home-circle");
const awayCircle = document.getElementById("away-circle");
const homeScorers = document.getElementById("home-scorers");
const awayScorers = document.getElementById("away-scorers");

let requestNumber = 0;

function setTeamColor(circle, kit) {
  circle.style.backgroundColor = kit?.jersey_color || "#aaaaaa";
  circle.style.borderColor = kit?.number_color || "#222222";
  circle.hidden = false;
}

function showGoalscorers(container, players, teamId) {
  container.replaceChildren();

  for (const player of players) {
    const ownTeam = String(player.team_id) === String(teamId);

    // Own goals are listed under the team that benefits.
    const goals = Number(ownTeam ? player.goal : player.own_goal) || 0;
    if (goals <= 0) continue;

    const name = (
      player.short_name ||
      `${player.first_name || ""} ${player.last_name || ""}`
    ).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

    const line = document.createElement("div");
    line.textContent =
      name +
      (goals > 1 ? ` ×${goals}` : "") +
      (!ownTeam ? " (own goal)" : "");

    container.appendChild(line);
  }
}

async function showScore() {
  const currentRequest = ++requestNumber;
  const matchId = window.selectedMatchId;

  home.textContent = score.textContent = away.textContent = "";
  homeCircle.hidden = awayCircle.hidden = true;
  homeScorers.replaceChildren();
  awayScorers.replaceChildren();

  if (!matchId) {
    message.textContent = "Select a game above.";
    return;
  }

  message.textContent = "Loading…";

  try {
    const id = encodeURIComponent(matchId);
    const response = await fetch(`data/${id}/${id}_match.json`);

    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Match file unavailable.");

    const match = await response.json();
    if (currentRequest !== requestNumber) return;

    home.textContent = match.home_team.name;
    away.textContent = match.away_team.name;
    score.textContent =
      `${match.home_team_score ?? "—"} : ${match.away_team_score ?? "—"}`;

    setTeamColor(homeCircle, match.home_team_kit);
    setTeamColor(awayCircle, match.away_team_kit);

    showGoalscorers(homeScorers, match.players || [], match.home_team.id);
    showGoalscorers(awayScorers, match.players || [], match.away_team.id);

    message.textContent = "";
  } catch (error) {
    if (currentRequest === requestNumber) {
      message.textContent = "Could not load the selected match.";
    }
  }
}

window.addEventListener("match-selected", showScore);
showScore();
</script>
```
